findings: Source freezes only the maximum sum of a contiguous subarray; empty-input behavior, numeric width, returned indices and implementation language are not preserved.
Candidate clearly declares a non-empty Java int[] to long reference contract and does not present it as source fact.
The ending-at-i DP invariant and best-so-far aggregation correctly preserve non-empty semantics, including all-negative arrays where zero is not a valid answer.
Independent prefix-sum interval enumeration, structurally different from Kadane and the writer nested-sum oracle, matches the candidate on exhaustive bounded arrays and 30,000 seeded random arrays.
Time O(n), auxiliary space O(1), no-input-mutation, interval-output extension, and no-fabrication boundaries are explicit.
